thread:
incident-bot: ⚠️ High error rate detected — spike in TLS handshake failures (525/handshake_failure) and 502s for api.redwood.ai across multiple Cloudflare POPs. Pager: on-call (maya rao)

maya rao: noticing cluster of TLS failures (~13:42 UTC). Synth probes from eu and na show ‘handshake_failure’ and abrupt resets. Dashboard: spikes in 5xx and increased connection resets.

emma li: I can reproduce from GCP us-east: curl to api.redwood.ai/health intermittently fails with 'tlsv1 alert handshake failure'.

ryan park: can folks paste dig/curl from different regions so we can rule out DNS TTL flips? Also check CF status page.

maya rao: probes:
```
# eu-central probe
$ dig api.redwood.ai @1.1.1.1 +short
api.redwood.ai.cf.edge.example.net.
104.21.12.34

$ curl -Iv https://api.redwood.ai/health
* Connected to 104.21.12.34 (104.21.12.34) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.2 (OUT), TLS alert, handshake failure (unknown)
* Closing connection 0
```

```
# us-west probe
$ curl -Iv https://api.redwood.ai/health
* Connected to 172.67.45.10 (172.67.45.10) port 443 (#0)
* SSL connection using TLSv1.2 / ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
* SSL peer shutdown incorrectly
```

danielle ortiz: Cloudflare status shows an incident for edge TLS: https://cloudflarestatus.com/incident/edge-tls-2026-2 — they indicate an upstream routing flap affecting handshake negotiation in several POPs.

liam oneil: auth provider (okta) reports elevated latency and token timeouts when requests route via CDN. We're seeing increased login failures and some token refresh errors. This likely amplifies customer impact.

emma li: impact estimate (quick): start ~13:42 UTC. Error rate in impacted regions: EU ~20%, NA west ~9%. Long-lived connections (streaming/generation) have higher failure probability.

ryan park: mitigation options on table: (1) coordinate with Cloudflare ops for immediate mitigation, (2) failover specific tenants to direct-origin bypass, (3) shift affected customers to Dedicated backends (not fronted by CF), (4) increase retries in SDKs temporarily.

maya rao: I'm going to initiate selective origin bypass for SLA customers first. We'll test with a small traffic slice before wider rollout. Command to set override:
```
# runtime-router
rw-router override --host api.redwood.ai --policy origin-bypass --targets origin-lb:100 --match tenant in (TENANT-ENT-001,TENANT-ENT-002)
```
I applied to first two tenants; telemetry shows their CF-bound requests drop ~80% and direct-origin hits increase.

emma li: run a certificate validation against the origin:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect origin-lb:443 -servername api.redwood.ai -showcerts
Certificate chain
 subject=/CN=api.redwood.ai
 issuer=/CN=Redwood Root CA
 verify return code: 0 (ok)
```

liam oneil: also did a curl with SNI explicitly: `curl --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:203.0.113.10 https://api.redwood.ai/health -Iv` — origin responds OK.

danielle ortiz: support-bot, flag customer success: beginning outreach to top impacted accounts, summarizing temporary bypass actions and recommended client retry guidance.

support-bot: Noted. CS is contacting affected customers and logging incoming tickets. Early reports: two enterprise customers saw failed token creation for web users. No data exfiltration reported.

ryan park: monitoring notes — Datadog traces are delayed ~45s for edge-ingested spans; native logs still available for real-time. Use ELK logs for immediate counts.

emma li: rolling origin-bypass to 5% of public traffic for canary now. Watching TLS handshake success and request latencies.

(3 minutes later)

maya rao: 5% canary shows success — bypassed traffic stable. Cloudflare errors persist for non-bypassed traffic in certain POPs. Increasing to 60% for public routes with careful watch.

ryan park: tagging note: add "cf-edge:tls-fallback" and "mitigation:origin-bypass" to all logs for later filtering. Also capture representative failed TLS handshakes for postmortem.

emma li: after bump to 60% overall error rate dropped from ~18% -> ~6%. Latency for bypassed traffic +50ms median.

danielle ortiz: drafted status page message: "We are investigating TLS handshake failures affecting API reachability through our CDN provider. We are working with the provider and routing critical tenants directly to origin to restore connectivity. We will post updates every 10 minutes." Published.

ryan park: engaged Cloudflare ticket #CF-31845 and asked for root cause ETA. They acknowledge backbone route flap and said edge ops are rolling a fix; ETA unknown.

maya rao: next steps — maintain origin-bypass for critical tenants, keep canary for public traffic, avoid flip-flopping. Plan rollback once CF confirms POP heal and we validate TLS success across all regions.

liam oneil: create an alert rule for SNI/handshake failures to auto-trigger tenant-level bypass for high-severity customers next time. Add runbook item to SRE playbook.

support-bot: CS requests a post-incident report for three enterprise customers. Marking severity: partial outage (degraded availability).

maya rao: handing off incident at 14:20 UTC to ryan park. I'll remain available if needed.

incident-bot: on-call handoff: maya rao -> ryan park at 14:20 UTC. Next update scheduled in 10 minutes.

ryan park: taking over. I'll coordinate with Cloudflare until they declare the incident resolved, and produce the RCA skeleton with timeline and mitigation rationale.

incident-bot: Incident status = mitigated (partial) — emergency origin bypass implemented for affected tenants and partial public traffic. Cloudflare continuing remediation.
